title: commercial opportunities - u.s. embassy & consulates in south africa
paragraphs: note: the u.s. embassy pretoria is aware of an ongoing tender scam using our name to fraudulently request sample items or money. if your business receives a tender from a “mr. kerry collins,” usa@embassytenders.com or info@embassytenders.com , please do not act on this request.
